html:
Running a small business these days means wearing many hats. One minute, you’re managing day-to-day operations. The other, you’re trying to build customer relationships; it’s a constant balancing act.

But what if you could leverage insights from your existing customer data to work smarter, not harder?

Meridian Local’s all-in-one business management platform is designed to help small to medium size companies organize, automate, and turn data into dollars. This post will take a closer look at how to use your customer data to boost revenue.

Capturing and Organizing Leads for Maximum Conversion

Your website is often the first touchpoint for potential new customers. But a steady stream of visitors doesn’t always translate into sales. The key is identifying promising leads and nurturing those relationships.

Let’s say you run an HVAC company. Over 63% of homeowners use online searches to find local services. If you have a well-optimized site, you likely attract many visitors looking for help with furnace repairs, AC installations, etc.

Without a system to capture that traffic, all those leads can easily fall through the cracks. Meanwhile, a plumbing business may get inquiries about clogged drains or leaky faucets. And a law firm could have prospective clients reaching out about divorce or real estate disputes.

No matter the industry, leads are invaluable. But remembering to follow up on each one takes significant effort. Knowing how to approach each one becomes increasingly difficult as the number of qualified leads increases.

Meridian Local’s Integrated Lead Capture and Management

Rather than scrambling to keep track of leads from your website, Meridian Local offers a streamlined system to handle it for you. Our software automatically collects contact info whenever someone fills out a form or requests a quote.

Leads are conveniently organized into one centralized dashboard—no more digging through emails or spreadsheets. You’ll have instant access to the name, company, phone number, email address, project details, and any other pertinent info provided.

With this complete overview, you can prioritize the most promising opportunities. Then, set reminders to prompt follow-up calls, emails, or quotes to close more deals. Even better, you can automate the whole process. More on this later.

Customer Communication for Better Engagement

Speaking of follow-up, sharp attention to customer care is critical for retention and repeat sales. Seventy-eight percent of customers won’t do business with a company again after a poor service experience. That churn can eat into revenues faster than you think.

A customer relationship management (CRM) system helps nurture positive interactions to turn one-time buyers into lifelong clients. By tracking correspondence history in one place, anyone on your team has the context to deliver personalized service.

When you bring meaningful communication to your customers on the regular, magic happens. They start to trust you. They feel valued. And when customers feel good about your business, they’re more likely to spend money with you.

For instance, a law firm’s CRM stores meeting notes, case details, billing records, and scheduled court dates. This data allows attorneys to have productive discussions with clients. They always have clear knowledge of their situations.

Meridian Local ties this customer information directly into the communication tools. Email campaigns, SMS messages, live chat conversations, and phone call logs are all documented for review. So your company can provide reliable service with relevant offers. This level of care breeds loyalty.

Email Campaigns and Targeted Marketing

Did you know that for every $1 spent on email marketing, businesses see an average return of $42? That’s a lot of bang for your buck! Email marketing remains an excellent vehicle for acquiring new business.

With customer data, you can segment recipients and customize content based on, you guessed it, data. Say your restaurant wants to boost Tuesday night dinner traffic. Sending an offer like “20 percent off this Tuesday!” to existing patrons who typically visit on weekends helps drive incremental sales.

In short, you can tailor your messages to specific customer groups, making them feel extra special and understood.

Meridian Local simplifies creating and sending beautiful automated email campaigns. You don’t need to be a design whiz or a tech guru. Our templates and builder make it easy to create eye-catching emails in minutes. These will have your customers eagerly clicking “open.”

Once again, you can automate everything, from the personalization you use to the send times and follow-ups.

Simplifying Customer Payments and Financial Management

Of course, all the lead conversion and customer retention efforts aim to generate revenue through sales. In the end, getting paid is the lifeblood of any small business.

However, juggling standalone payment processing, accounting software, and paper files for financials isn’t efficient. Many small business owners handle finances and billing themselves. That takes precious time away from serving customers and growing the business.

Meridian Local integrates seamless payment acceptance with automated invoicing and expense tracking in one unified platform. The platform automates the billing process, so you can focus on running your business instead of playing bill collector.

Plus, you can track your expenses, revenue, and profitability all in one convenient location.

Measuring and Optimizing Marketing Performance

Thus far, we’ve covered how Meridian Local helps you turn customer data into revenue. But how do you know if you’re going in the right direction? Are you leaving money on the table, or is there something you should be doing more of?

A data-driven approach enables smarter decision-making. It shows you where to allocate time, money, and other resources for maximum ROI. Yes, measuring marketing performance tells you what’s working and what to tweak.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are the biggest indicators here. Track website visits, lead conversion rates, sales closed from different campaigns, customer lifetime value, and more with visitor tracking tools.

Compare email success rates, monitor digital ad costs per lead, see which service upsells customers accept most. In short, you can fine-tune operations to increase revenue with customer data.

Turn Data Into Dollars With Meridian Local

At its core, Meridian Local is here to help small businesses spend more time on their services. More time delighting clients. Centralizing your customer data is the first step to unlocking this potential.

Stop playing catchup across disjointed systems.

  • Eliminate losing leads and missing follow-up opportunities.
  • Build meaningful customer relationships.
  • Develop focused marketing campaigns.
  • Simplify getting paid.
  • Evaluate performance with data-driven insights.
